integrity: The theorem is proved analytically by a probability-integral transform and beta-binomial mixing. The exact-rational checker verifies finite identities but is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a continuous strictly increasing null CDF, an independent observed null statistic, and the canonical inverse-CDF antithetic coupling. It does not cover arbitrary antithetic permutations, discrete laws, estimated null distributions, or general dependent resampling.
title: Exact calibration boundary for inverse-CDF antithetic Monte Carlo p-values
